name: Devotee of the Holy Prophecies
body:
As an adherent of the ancient prophecies you understand the importance of a good deal.

Benefit: You gain a +1 trait bonus on Appraise checks, and a +1 trait bonus on Bluff checks when trying to make a deal with nonbelievers.
